definitions.explanation: A person who paints or draws pictures, especially as a profession. A casual, everyday word compared with {画家|がか}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絵描|えか}きだ。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{絵描|えか}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I wanted to be a painter ever since I was a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売|う}れない→売れる：02012_ureru⟧{絵描|えか}き⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: Apparently he struggled for a long time as a painter who couldn't sell his work.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (picture) + ⟦{描|か}き→描く：28436_kaku⟧ (drawing, from ⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧). A plain, slightly informal word for a painter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵描|えか}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a painter
- ⟦{売|う}れない→売れる：02012_ureru⟧{絵描|えか}き: a struggling / unsuccessful painter
- {絵描|えか}き⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧: a drawing song (a children's song that guides drawing a picture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧: painter — more formal and dignified, used for established artists
- ⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧: artist — broader, covers all the arts
